france.coverage: 245 higher-education institution entries plus the 2026 Parcoursup undergraduate catalogue. Every course has a sourced tuition planning figure using public/private and apprenticeship context where matched; estimates are distinct from published course fees.

uk.coverage: Student-route sponsor register plus 32,533 eligible undergraduate course/location records for 2027–28 from HESA Discover Uni 2026. Missing course fees use British Council international tuition planning ranges, not provider quotes.

usa.coverage: IPEDS institutions (2024) and College Scorecard historical field/credential records (updated 2026-06-10), not a current admissions catalogue. Approximate budgets use 2023–24 IPEDS institution-level out-of-state fees or peer ranges; they are not current course-specific quotes.

canada.coverage: All post-secondary designated learning institution campus rows, plus 22 University of British Columbia undergraduate programme fees published for international students for 2026/27. Not a complete Canadian course or fee catalogue.

germany.coverage: ROR education-type organization records (CC0), plus 4 Technical University of Munich degree fees officially published for international students from third countries. Broad registry is not a complete list of state-recognized universities.

australia.coverage: CRICOS provider records and 25,542 non-expired registered courses (tuition amount included in 25,360 records; snapshot 2026-10-14).

ireland.coverage: HEA-listed publicly funded/core-funded institutions, plus 2026/27 course-level non-EU fee rows from University College Cork and Trinity College Dublin. Not all QQI-validated private providers.
